evidence_study_note: The causal evidence (WorkAdvance RCT), national parameters (CPI, payroll tax, fringe, federal tax, discounting) and Monte Carlo design are read unchanged from the Utah study. Only state-specific inputs below differ.
reference_taxable_income_note: State income tax is applied at the single-filer statutory marginal rate on this taxable income, a rough level for a WorkAdvance-type participant. Analyst choice, tier D.
workadvance_site_states_note: Per Scholas and St. Nicks Alliance ran in New York City, Madison Strategies Group in Tulsa and Towards Employment in Cleveland. Statewide medians are a coarse proxy for those local labor markets.

rate_overrides.reason: The Tax Foundation table is as of January 1, 2025 and shows 4.55%. Utah cut the rate to 4.5% for tax year 2025; this matches the Utah study's registered parameter.
